bibl.title: Śukasandeśa
bibl.note: Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002.

This work is suggested as possibly by Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita by K. Kunjunni Raja in Uṇādimaṇidīpikā, p. 42. Thiruvengadathan says that the work is yet to be traced. For this discussion see Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002: p. 17.
